none: PAS NMS-02C2C3: Fragment of Roman bracelet
contea di ritrovamento: Norfolk (Inghilterra e Galles)

Incomplete and distorted Roman sheet copper alloy pennannular bracelet, one end broken. Engraved decoration comprises three pairs of longitudinal grooves with multiple transverse dashes. Just before the straight terminal the pairs stop at two transverse rows of dashes, and between them are two impressions that resemble letters, a C and a D or O. the resemblance is probable coincidental.
